title: 🚨 YOUR CHILDREN ARE BEING DISCIPLED... THE QUESTION IS BY WHO?
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR CHILDREN ARE BEING DISCIPLED... THE QUESTION IS BY WHO?
Every day, someone is teaching your family what to believe.

Social media.
Entertainment.
Friends.
Culture.
And if you're not intentionally discipling your family...
someone else will.
That's the uncomfortable truth many Christian homes don't want to face.
"HOW TO LEAD A FAMILY DEVOTION"
Most Christian parents want a God-centered home.
Few actually build one.
Not because they don't love God.
But because they feel overwhelmed...
"I don't know enough Bible."
"I don't know where to start."
"My family won't listen."
"My schedule is too busy."
This powerful new guide will show you how to lead your family spiritually—even if you've never done it before.
🔥 INSIDE THIS BOOK YOU'LL DISCOVER:
✅ A simple family devotion framework anyone can follow
✅ How to lead Scripture discussions without being a Bible expert
✅ Practical ways to keep children engaged
✅ How to build a culture of prayer inside your home
✅ Common mistakes that destroy consistency
✅ Biblical principles for leaving a lasting spiritual legacy
✅ Step-by-step guidance for creating a Christ-centered household
This is not theory.
This is practical discipleship for real families.
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS FEW PEOPLE
Most people hope their family grows closer to God.
Few intentionally create time for God.
Most people complain about culture.
Few build a stronger culture inside their own home.
Most people want a godly legacy.
Few make daily decisions that create one.
Which group will you belong to?
